operation.description:
List custom images for an organization.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `manage_runners:org` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: List custom images for an organization

#/components/parameters/org.description: The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/org.name: org

#/components/schemas/actions-hosted-runn.description: Provides details of a custom runner image

id.description: The ID of the image. Use this ID for the `image` parameter when creating a new larger runner.

latest_version.description: The latest image version associated with the image.

platform.description: The operating system of the image.

state.description: The number of image versions associated with the image.

total_versions_size.description: Total size of all the image versions in GB.

versions_count.description: The number of image versions associated with the image.

#/components/schemas/actions-hosted-runn.title: GitHub-hosted runner custom image details
